templates.why_chosen: Reassigned from composite-figure by the note-writer: both panels are sequential stages of one planning algorithm, template generation then plan instantiation, sharing one grayscale grid-of-squares glyph as a running anchor; that is two-panel's two-stages-of-one-thing case, not composite-figure's mix of unlike kinds.
templates.what_to_learn: Reuse one consistent glyph, here a grid of light/medium/dark squares sized by node count, across every panel of a multi-stage algorithm figure so a template's identity carries from generation through instantiation to the best-plan output; that continuity is a two-panel technique, not a reason to fragment into unlike-kind composite panels.
